title: Studio Day Rate Schedule for Bench Days Given Back
content:
# Studio Day Rate Schedule for Bench Days Given Back

USD 30.00, USD 18.00 and USD 8.00 a day are the rates at which the bench days a change gives back are charged on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three is taken turns on the quoted total standing on the commission and on how long the piece has stood at the bench.

## The rates

1. Where the quoted total on the commission stands at or above three quarters, that is 0.75, of the largest value the programme is offered for, and the piece has stood at the bench for longer than the studio's bench settling days, which are 2, the bench days are charged at USD 30.00 a day.
2. Where the quoted total stands at or above the smallest value the programme is offered for and below three quarters of the largest, and the piece has stood at the bench for longer than 2 days, they are charged at USD 18.00 a day.
3. Otherwise they are charged at USD 8.00 a day.

How long the piece has stood at the bench is counted from the date production began to the day the change is priced; a piece that has stood there 2 days or fewer has not stood there for longer than the bench settling days.

## The programme values the rates turn on

| Programme | Smallest quoted total | Largest quoted total | Three quarters of the largest |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | USD 1499.00 | USD 7999.00 | USD 5999.25 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | USD 2999.00 | USD 19999.00 | USD 14999.25 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | USD 5999.00 | USD 49999.00 | USD 37499.25 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | USD 14999.00 | USD 149999.00 | USD 112499.25 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | USD 7999.00 | USD 89999.00 | USD 67499.25 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | USD 39999.00 | USD 999999.00 | USD 749999.25 |

## Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical)

Under Belrose Bespoke Design, whose smallest value is USD 5999.00 and whose largest is USD 49999.00, with the piece at the bench for 9 days:

| Quoted total | Rate |
|---|---|
| USD 37499.25, which is three quarters of the largest | USD 30.00 a day |
| USD 37499.24 | USD 18.00 a day |
| USD 5999.00 | USD 18.00 a day |
| USD 5998.99 | USD 8.00 a day |

The same commission quoted at USD 40000.00 with the piece at the bench for 2 days is charged at USD 8.00 a day, because the piece has not stood at the bench for longer than the bench settling days.
